question: **When the guests arrived, Anna: **

options.text: excitedly took them to meet the Prince
took some of them to meet her aunt
took each one to meet her aunt

solution:
The correct answer is:** took each one to meet her aunt**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• It is said in the first sentence of the second paragraph of the given passage, "*To each new arrival Anna Pávlovna said,__ “You have not yet seen my aunt,” or “You do not know my aunt?” __and very gravely conducted him or her to a little old lady__*"
 
• So it is clear that When the guests arrived, Anna took each one to meet her aunt.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.
